subject: Intro demo — propose switching to POC kickoff / technical deep dive
messages:
From: Jordan Wilson <j.wilson@acmesys.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmesys.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — quick intro call

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the materials. We'd like to schedule the intro demo you mentioned — next week works for our team. The goals are: get a surface-level demo of hosted API latency/cost controls and understand how a POC would look from a technical and procurement perspective.

Two quick notes: I (Jordan) will be traveling to NYC Sep 7–10 but can do virtual meetings. Procurement would also like a short run-through of deployment options because of our compliance requirements.

Proposed slot: Sep 9 at 10:00 AM PT. Does that work? If possible, can we make the session a little more technical — maybe frame it as a short POC kickoff rather than a pure sales demo so we can invite engineering?

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Wilson
Senior Solutions Architect, Acme Systems
[j.wilson@acmesys.com]

[Attachment: initial_requirements.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 32 KB)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Wilson <j.wilson@acmesys.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — quick intro call

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear ask.

We can absolutely pivot the meeting to be a technical POC kickoff / architecture deep dive. Marcus (cc'd) would lead the technical portion and Evelyn can cover onboarding and procurement checkpoints.

Quick question on scope so we prep the right artifacts:
- Do you want a hands-on scoping session with sample prompts and an API walkthrough, or an architecture-focused discussion (networking, VPC/private options, and SLA)?
- Any non-negotiable compliance points we should put on the agenda (e.g., required KMS/HSM, data residency)?

Proposed times (all PT):
- Sep 9, 10:00–11:30 (Jordan is traveling but can join virtually)
- Sep 10, 9:00–10:30
- Sep 14, 1:00–2:30

I attached a draft mutual action plan and a short network checklist so Marcus can tailor the deep dive. If Sep 9 works, we can keep it virtual and focus on architecture + quick hands-on demo. If you'd prefer an engineering workshop with participants sharing a couple of sample prompts, we can make the session 90–120 minutes.

Files attached: MAP_v1.pdf, network_requirements.xlsx

Thanks — please confirm a slot and the desired format and we'll send a calendar invite and an updated MAP.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Olga — thanks for the options and the MAP. Two items:
1) Travel conflict update: I have an on-site customer visit that afternoon on Sep 9 — the 10:00 AM PT slot will be tight for me. Sep 10 at 9:00 AM PT is the best from my side (will be remote but fully available).
2) Format: Let's do the architecture-focused deep dive (networking, private VPC options, and what redwood needs for a POC) with 45–60 minutes of hands-on API/latency demo. We'll invite our lead infra engineer and procurement.

Can Marcus lead the technical segment and leave 15 minutes at the end for procurement questions? Procurement will also want a one-page summary of required evidence for compliance (SOC2, encryption at rest/in-transit, audit log availability).

If Sep 10 9:00 AM PT works for your team, go ahead and send the invite.

—Jordan
